# opnsense_syslog_settings (Resource)

Local logging settings (**System ▸ Settings ▸ Logging**): writing logs to disk and their retention. Remote targets are `opnsense_syslog_destination` resources. This is a singleton: import it with the ID `syslog_settings` before managing it. Attributes left unset keep their current value.

## Example Usage

```terraform
import {
  to = opnsense_syslog_settings.this
  id = "syslog_settings"
}

resource "opnsense_syslog_settings" "this" {
  loglocal    = true
  maxpreserve = 14
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) enabled.
- `loglocal` (Boolean) Enable writing log files to the local disk.
- `maxfilesize` (Number) Maximum file size per log file. When set and a log file exceeds the amount specified, it will be rotated. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `maxpreserve` (Number) Number of logs to preserve. When no maximum file size is offered or the logs are smaller than the the size requested, this equals the number of days. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `syslog_settings`.
